# Marker surgery test fixtures

`paragraph-marker-synthetic.pdf` is compiled from the public synthetic sources in `latex-source/project`. It contains no private paper content. The baseline is retained to exercise the actual Type1 stream and raster output deterministically.

`LMRoman7-Regular.otf` is the unmodified Latin Modern Roman 7 font from MiKTeX's `fonts/opentype/public/lm/lmroman7-regular.otf`. SHA-256: `48c4b46ab255eec96588fb992fba1ed6102e53d051da480738a61cc6cdb328c3`. Its GUST Font License accompanies it as `LICENSE-LM`.
